_doc: docs-sync suite. Each case is a folder = one small repo. `drifts` lists the seeded places where a doc disagrees with the code; an empty list marks a clean control. A reported item finds a drift when it names `doc`, sits within `tolerance` lines of the anchor's line in that doc, AND its claim/reality text contains one of `keywords` (case-insensitive). run.py checks every anchor resolves to exactly one line. Reported items that match no drift are counted as extra (on a drift case) or false alarms (on a control) and are listed for a hand check.

drifts.what: README imports and calls parse_ledger; the package exports load_ledger (renamed in 2.0).
README documents --dry-run; bin/shrink.js's parseArgs has no such option (parseArgs is strict, so it errors).
README says config/settings.yaml; pinger/config.py reads conf/app.yaml.
README links docs/deploy.md, which does not exist (only docs/operations.md does).
README calls send(..., retries=5); Client.send takes keyword-only max_retries, so the snippet raises TypeError.
Codemap lists src/billing/invoice.ts; the module lives at src/invoicing/invoice.ts.
Codemap lists an exportCsv export; invoice.ts exports only createInvoice, voidInvoice and markPaid.
